Full-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole. Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling. Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders. Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else. Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.
